title: Qualification, oracle, and build-evidence workflows

sources.notes: Models source-inspected linkage facts only: B70 composes the Phase-1 provider, grouped objects, QuixiCore-XPU, Level Zero and oneDNN under icpx/SYCL; the CPU library is a separate stock-g++/pthread target. Explicit Xe2 header prerequisites prevent stale grouped objects. No successful build is inferred.

Models the three-run assertion workflow: subset baseline, allout with zero CPU experts for exact policy parity, and a live CPU tier requiring loader verification, positive routes/dispatches, zero poller errors/skipped routes, resident experts and coherent output. This is test acceptance, not production execution semantics.

Models fresh all-CUDA and split:128+B70 child runs, mandatory hybrid marker, exact-token acceptance and the narrow fallback where both texts contain 42. Provider and hybrid computation remain in their owning branches.
Provides packed-byte fixtures and the vLLM dequantization plus FP32 SwiGLU oracle used for CPU-tier differential checks. The Reyu model abstracts tensor payloads to oracle-agreement evidence.

Models the aggregate assertion result for exact ownership, compact-id order and masks, stock tail behavior, policy agreement, version-sensitive loader naming, pre-super attribute ordering, accessor consistency and missing-bank refusal. Placement itself is not reimplemented.

Models a warmed long-prompt TTFT measurement set with derived prefill throughput and dispatches per layer. The observed curve diagnoses chunking, dispatch overhead or kernel throughput; it is not a correctness proof.

Shell launcher has no declared function symbols. It supplies one fresh process per chunk size because pinned staging buffers are construction-sized, and sweeps CHUNKS, LENGTHS and TRIALS into per-chunk JSON outputs.

Models prompt/generated logprob completeness and finiteness plus, for requested B70 hybrid runs, stable provider generation, health, positive dispatch delta and graph-poller activity. Optional diagnostic hooks observe or fail the probe; they are not serving features.

Launches all-CUDA, Phase-6 B70, forced-stream and all-out cases, optionally reusing cached JSON. Its final comparison prints prompt-logprob deltas but enforces no numeric closeness threshold, so oracleClose is explicit external evidence in the model.

Models the availability and measurement evidence for a deployment-specific CPU-moe_forward versus CUDA ExpertStreamer crossover. Realistic filtered routes, a forced cold route for empty small samples, warmup and synchronized median timing are source behavior; no universal threshold is inferred.

Models actual-provider assertions for exact wire selection (only environment value 1 means FP16), shape, finiteness and scalar oracle agreement; and grouped overflow-range preservation, numerical agreement, scratch reuse isolation and exact zero for invalid routes across both pipeline and wire modes. These are assertions, not provider implementation.

Generated historical comparison with no symbols or runtime behavior. It records 3/8 exact token agreement, common prefixes, KV-cache tokens, and captured throughput/ITL differences; values are evidence for one run, not guarantees or policy.
Generated subset:16:8 hybrid result bank with correctness, single-stream, batched, prefill and worker snapshots. It is an input to comparison.json and has no executable symbols.
Generated all-CUDA result bank with correctness, single-stream, batched, prefill and worker snapshots. It is the captured baseline for comparison.json and has no executable symbols.
Referenced by the preemptive assertion harness. Ownership behavior is modeled in the placement branch; qualification only records assertion outcomes.
Referenced for host-tier bank admission/refusal and hybrid execution. Qualification does not duplicate routed execution.
Supplies packed fixtures and native CPU execution to the differential/crossover programs. Storage and execution semantics belong to the CPU-tier branch.
Supplies the CUDA streaming side of the deployment-specific crossover comparison; residency/streaming semantics are modeled elsewhere.
Linked into the Phase-7 B70 library and exercised by actual-provider tests. Provider state and issue/take semantics belong to the provider model.

assumptions: Qualification actions summarize assertions over other subsystems; passing them does not add behavior to the production serving path.
Fresh-process comparisons inherit an explicit model, bank, library, driver, vLLM and hardware environment; parity is meaningful only when those identities are controlled.
The hybrid semantic fallback is intentionally limited to both outputs containing 42 and is not a general semantic-equivalence oracle.
Prompt-logprob closeness to all-CUDA is an external comparison because prefill_probe.sh prints deltas but does not enforce a tolerance.
Only the exact string value 1 selects the FP16 B70 result wire in the covered binding; unset, 0 and 01 are FP32 cases.
CUDA absence makes the crossover unavailable; it does not establish that CPU compute is faster.
Phase-10 JSON values are generated historical observations and must not be promoted to current performance, parity, capacity or SLO guarantees.
The all-out harness phrase bf16 CPU GEMM describes compute precision informally; packed NVFP4 storage and dequantized floating-point computation are the source-backed representation boundary.
Reyu tensor and timing observations are abstract and atomic; floating-point tolerance, subprocess execution, driver ordering and performance require implementation evidence.

implementation_checks.description: CPU-executable assertion sweep for disjoint/full ownership, compact sorted CUDA ids, offload masks, stock tail layers, policy agreement, loader-name compatibility, module initialization ordering, accessor consistency and missing-bank refusal.
Differentially compare CPU-tier native output against vLLM dequantization of identical packed NVFP4 bytes followed by the FP32 SwiGLU reference; cover nibble codes, scale exponents and global scale.

Compare subset:K:N against allout:K:N:0 for exact policy parity, then require a live all-out CPU run to report loader verification, positive CPU routes/poller dispatches, zero errors/skips and coherent output.

On a qualified deployment, compare CpuExpertHost.moe_forward and ExpertStreamer.forward over identical packed experts and sampled cold routes to derive a local threshold; report pinning state and retain raw points rather than universalizing the crossover.
With an explicitly supplied actual B70 library, compare FP16/FP32 wire dtype and values against the deterministic unit-bank sigmoid oracle for unset, 0, 1 and 01 flag values.

With the actual provider, compare grouped output against the float64 oracle around FP16 overflow, repeat after changing activations to detect scratch-scale leakage, and require exact zero for all-invalid routes under both pipelines and wire modes.

For a controlled real-model run, inspect complete finite prompt/generated logprobs and verify provider generation stability, health and dispatch deltas; compare the saved mean prompt logprob with an identity-matched all-CUDA baseline using an explicitly chosen tolerance.
Source-inspect that the saved report records only 3 of 8 exact token matches and treat this as a counterexample to blanket token-identical hybrid claims, not as a current-code test.
